Player.<RumbleState>k__BackingField.reason: Controller vibration request. Reads in InputUpdater affect hardware vibration; reads in CastSpell, Roll, and MeteorSmash only clear the vibration request.

PokeBall.wigglePhase.reason: Only updated in MonoBehaviour.Update and read to rotate the child SpriteRenderer. Capture clocks and victim physics remain compared.

DeathEffect2.prevDisp.reason: Only read and written by LateUpdate to shake the Unity Transform. The effect uses FixTransform.position for simulation queries; hit-stop and animation clocks remain compared.

QuickSpell.ParticleOnCast.reason: A ParticleSystem reference assigned on cast and used only to set its visual scale. Particle expiry runs on rendering time. Spell logic and fixed state remain compared.

SimpleSparkNode.timeSinceActivated.reason: Updated only by MonoBehaviour.Update and reset when connecting nodes. Its only read evaluates ScaleAnim for the LitOrbs[1] sprite flare transform; lightning activation uses the separate fixed SpriteAnimator clock, which stays compared.

BlackHole.onEatParticles.reason: List of cosmetic ParticleSystems from SpawnParticle. UpdateSim only removes expired references and updates orbital particle offsets; gravity, mass, consumed bodies and black-hole clocks remain compared.

Portal.ageVisual.reason: Only read and written in LateUpdate for sprite scale/color and cosmetic sparkles. Portal crossing tests use fixed position, normal, tangent, halfWidth and thickness; lifetime uses separate fixed timeAlive. All these gameplay fields remain compared.

Portal.spinPhase.reason: Only read and written in LateUpdate for sprite scale/color and cosmetic sparkles. Portal crossing tests use fixed position, normal, tangent, halfWidth and thickness; lifetime uses separate fixed timeAlive. All these gameplay fields remain compared.

Portal.sparkleTimer.reason: Only read and written in LateUpdate for sprite scale/color and cosmetic sparkles. Portal crossing tests use fixed position, normal, tangent, halfWidth and thickness; lifetime uses separate fixed timeAlive. All these gameplay fields remain compared.

DuplicatePlatformEffect.effectShake.reason: Only subtracted from and added to the platformShaderEffect sprite transform, using Unity cosmetic RNG. The platform itself uses newPlatformPos and its fixed collider; these remain compared.

SuperStarEffect.shimmerPhase.reason: Only used by LateUpdate for tint shimmer and ambient ParticleSystem spawning. Buff duration, invulnerability, collision force and ability form state use separate fixed fields, which remain compared.

SuperStarEffect.sparkTimer.reason: Only used by LateUpdate for tint shimmer and ambient ParticleSystem spawning. Buff duration, invulnerability, collision force and ability form state use separate fixed fields, which remain compared.

SuperStarEffect.lastTintedForm.reason: Tracks the SpriteRenderer whose color LateUpdate last changed, so RestoreTint can restore its visual tint. Only those two presentation methods read/write this reference; fixed buff lifetime and collision/invulnerability fields stay compared.
